title: Darjeeling Tiger Hill Sunrise & Tea Gardens
highlights: Tiger Hill sunrise over Mt. Kanchenjunga
Evening tea tastings on Darjeeling Mall Road

days.label: Day 1
days.title: NJP / IXB to Darjeeling - Foothill Drive & Chowrasta
days.text: Pickup from Bagdogra Airport (IXB) or NJP Railway Station. Scenic 3-4 hour climb winding through emerald tea gardens. Check into your hotel and enjoy an evening stroll along Darjeeling Chowrasta.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Darjeeling Full Day Heritage & Nature Sightseeing
days.text: Comprehensive city tour visiting Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park (Red Panda & Snow Leopard sanctuary), Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Darjeeling Ropeway, Japanese Peace Pagoda, and Tibetan Refugee Centre.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Tiger Hill Sunrise & Drop to NJP / IXB
days.text: Early morning drive to Tiger Hill (2,590 m) to witness the sunrise over Kanchenjunga. Visit Batasia Loop and Ghoom Monastery on the return, enjoy breakfast, and depart to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport.

included: Private cab for all transfers and city sightseeing
Early morning Tiger Hill and Batasia Loop excursion
Railway station or Bagdogra Airport pickup and drop
